full_name: Paul Desenne | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Arts Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music FESNOJIV (El Sistema) (Venezuela)
bio: Venezuelan composer and cellist Paul Desenne’s recent work is steeped in the counterpoint of Bach, music of the 16th century, and contemporary techniques; he is influenced always by the rich forms of Latin American music.
